rendered: LFP has the highest practical capacity among LCO, LNO and LFP according to the review. It is given as 170 mAh g^− 1[1] (from the LFP passage), while LCO is given only ≈140 mAh g^− 1[2] as available for practical applications. The review gives no practical capacity for LNO; it gives only its theoretical capacity, ≈ 275 mAh g^− 1[3]. For LCO, the theoretical capacity is 274 mAh g^− 1[4], so LCO's practical capacity is roughly half its theoretical value: the review says LCO has a high theoretical capacity, although typically only about ≈140 mAh g^− 1[5] is available for practical applications.
